blocks.text: Capillaries arterioles ke batne se banti hain, aur capillaries aapas mein mil kar venules banati hain. Capillaries jism ke har tissue mein ghus jati hain aur cells tak pohanchti hain. Capillary ki deewar endothelial cells ki sirf ek tah se bani hoti hai. Capillary ka andar ka qutr (diameter) taqreeban 8 micrometre hota hai. Capillaries hi woh jagah hain jahan khoon aur jism ke tissues ke darmiyan cheezon ka len den (exchange) hota hai; yeh len den diffusion (zyada se kam miqdar ki taraf phailna) ya active transport (energy laga kar le jana) se hota hai. Pani aur diffuse hone wali cheezein capillary ki deewar se guzar sakti hain. Cheezein ya to endothelial cells ke andar se, ya cells ke darmiyan ki khali jagahon (intercellular spaces) se guzarti hain. Kuch cheezon ko capillary ki deewar ke cells endocytosis (cell ka cheez ko nigal lena) se andar lete hain aur phir exocytosis (cell se bahar nikalna) ke zariye doosri taraf chhor dete hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Jism ka koi bhi cell kisi capillary se 100 micrometre se zyada door nahin. Capillaries itni tang hain ke RBCs un mein se ek qatar (single line) mein guzarte hain. Andaza hai ke ek baligh insan ki tamam capillaries ki kul lambai 80,600 kilometre se zyada hai, jo zameen ke gird do chakkar lagane ke liye kafi hai!

Capillaries ke andar dabao ki wajah se blood plasma ka kuch mayah musalsal bahar tissues mein risata rehta hai. Is mayah ko interstitial fluid kehte hain. Yeh pani hai jis mein ghule hue nutrients, hormones, gases, fuzla (wastes) aur chhote proteins hote hain. Bare proteins, RBCs aur platelets capillaries ke andar hi rehte hain. Lekin kuch WBCs capillary ki deewar ke cells ke beech ki jagahon se nichur kar (squeeze ho kar) bahar nikal sakte hain.
